verdict.rationale: Egnyte is a content-management platform, so a preview or thumbnail API is a fair question for it. The evidence never shows thumbnails or embeddable previews served through an API call. The only preview-related item is in-app video playback in file preview mode, which is a user-facing UI feature, not a developer preview endpoint.

support.subject: As a developer, previews are an API call — thumbnails and embeddable document previews served for common formats without me rendering them
